prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished finished gameplay UI screenshot for original PC narrative adventure 《来自月亮的 Z》, landscape 16:9. Use reference image 1 (06-private-dialogue) for the definitive lateral 2.5D game staging, small adult character proportions and unobtrusive dialogue UI. Use reference image 2 (island-map-v2) for the cohesive painterly palette and simplified material finish ONLY, not its bird's-eye camera. Designed rock/wood planes, grouped pine silhouettes, subtle hand-painted surfaces, blue-violet coastal atmosphere, warm amber practical lights, ivory Chinese typography, coral active interaction, translucent charcoal surfaces with delicate imperfect outlines. Premium painterly game art, not photoreal, not miniature 3D, not anime portraits. Small adult characters ~18-23% screen height. Consistent protagonist: adult brown-haired man, rust-orange jacket, dark trousers, visible small stage-crew lanyard. Readable layered horizontal traversable environment with clear ground plane. No panels over faces. UI is quiet and spatial, not a dashboard, not an e-commerce website. Use high-quality perfectly readable Simplified Chinese sans typography, no gibberish or unnecessary English. Plenty of negative space around all text; generous margins. No health bars, awakening/trust stats, omniscient safety meters, portrait cards, or marketing headings.
SUBJECT: The harbor street, where the player asks different NPCs for information. Eye-level lateral 2.5D coastal street with a timber visitor kiosk on the left, old low houses, railings, ropes and a moored boat on the right, steps to an upper street, open indigo sea. Cool overcast daytime, slightly warm sunlight breaking through clouds; amber lamps under eaves. No lighthouse in this frame. Four adult people only: protagonist and a middle-aged woman visitor clerk near the center-left kiosk; one dock worker by rope coils on the right; one stage manager holding a clipboard on the upper walkway. Make people grounded and naturally occupied. Labels for the two other NPCs indicate topics, not simultaneous conversations. Main current interaction is visitor clerk and player.
Top-left exact:
“第 5 日 · 准备时段”
“码头小街”
Above the distant but visible dock worker, fine unobtrusive label with small talk icon:
“码头工人”
smaller “船班消息”
Above the distant visible stage manager on upper walkway:
“场务负责人”
smaller “维护安排”
Near the visitor clerk (one clear delicate dialogue bubble, charcoal backing, ivory text, shaped tail to HER):
name “访客管理员”
quote on two natural lines “维护员傍晚会去灯塔。”
“具体几点，你得问场务。”
Near the protagonist, two short floating dialogue choices (tails point toward protagonist), first selected coral:
“灯塔今天谁值班？”
“晚上的船几点离开？”
Bottom-right an understated compact translucent notebook information annotation occupying at most 22% screen width, no heavy border:
small coral heading “新线索”
“傍晚有维护作业”
smaller “来源：访客管理员”
amber small hollow circle with “尚未核实”
This is a claim recorded from NPC speech, not omniscient confirmed truth.
Bottom-left hints “A / D  移动” and “E  交谈”; bottom center quiet line “Tab  查看记录”; bottom far-right “Esc  结束交谈”. Keep footer separate from notebook so no overlap. Do not add a free AI input field for every NPC; this screen is investigation topics and sourced information. Hero is the inviting coastal street, with legible people and minimal talking UI.
